name: ow-eilx
description: Create render-first visual explainers that adapt to the learner and hand off generated HTML with a clickable link for viewing or sharing.

interface.displayName: OW EILX — Explain It Like X
interface.longDescription: Choose a preset or describe your own style. EILX uses host rendering when available, adapts pictures, diagrams, and words to the learner, and links any generated HTML file for local viewing or sharing.
defaultPrompt: Explain quantum computing like I'm five.
Explain Kubernetes like a patient teacher.
Explain this like a senior engineer with diagrams.
